title: Chapter 193 Sandbox Game
content:
Chapter 193 Sandbox Game

"In the spring of 9940 in the Imperial Calendar, skeleton soldiers appeared in Pianqiao Village, Xianhe Town, Black Dragon City."

Wang Shuo was thinking when he saw this text.

It seems that this side quest is to continuously obtain this incomplete report.

After a careful search again, there is no other discovery here.

Wang Shuo and others left the room.

Walked to a fork in the passage.

Two forks appeared.

Every few steps in the passage, there are scattered undead guards standing guard.

This naturally cannot stop Wang Shuo and others.

After a while, they came to the door of a side hall, which read "Command Center".

After killing the guard, they entered the gate.

I saw a skeleton general wearing a black hood, covered with black and shiny armor, holding a sword, sitting next to a sand table, with a murderous look all over his body!

But the strange thing is that after Wang Shuo and others entered, he did not attack immediately.

[Undead Guard Commander You Yong (Intermediate General)]

[Level: Level 38]

[Attack: 800]

[Defense: 300]

[HP: 7000]

[Note: Commander of the Black Dragon City Guard, likes to play chess. ]

After checking the other party's information, Wang Shuo concentrated and became alert.

"Are you here to play chess with me?" Undead Guard Commander You Yong laughed strangely.

I'm here to play chess with you!

"I'm here to investigate the truth of the destruction of Black Dragon City. Do you have any clues?" Wang Shuo didn't rush to do it.

You Yong stood up and said to the sand table with his eye sockets without eyeballs: "I have. As long as you beat me in chess, I will give you the clues!"

[Do you agree to play a game with You Yong? ]

Wang Shuo was in a dilemma. He was not good at playing chess at all!

But if he didn't agree, the clue would be broken, which would be difficult to deal with!

Obviously, this is the rule of the game.

Just as Wang Shuo hesitated, the surrounding environment changed.

"Hey, hey! I haven't agreed yet!"

At this time, Wang Shuo was in a military tent.

There was still a huge sand table in front of him. There were two military tents in the sand table. The tent where Wang Shuo was located was blue, and there was a red tent on the opposite side.

[You have entered You Yong's chess game. The strength of the red side is equal to yours. Kill all the red soldiers of the other side or break through the enemy camp to win. ]

Wang Shuo walked out of the big tent and found that his subordinates were all blue equipment, and the number of people and equipment attributes did not change.

This made Wang Shuo relieved.

Wang Shuo called Ayub and others into the military tent and began to discuss this battle.

"Have you ever encountered such a situation before?" Wang Shuo's eyes swept across everyone's faces one by one.

Guliji and Baililiang were also newcomers, and they shook their heads like Wang Shuo.

As for Ayub, Gong Zheng and Li Jianguo, they also shook their heads.

Maybe they had experienced it before, but they didn't remember it now.

Wang Shuo asked Chang Gui again.

"Lord, I have played chess and go before, but this is the first time I have encountered a real-life chess game."

Wang Shuo also showed a helpless expression, it seems that he has to cross the river by feeling the stones.

"Guliji, you go to the opposite side first and scout the enemy situation."

"Yes, Lord."

"Li Jianguo, you and Baili Liang will set up defenses in the base camp first."

"Ayubu, Gong Zheng and I will go to survey the nearby terrain first."

Wang Shuo ordered everyone.

Walk out of the camp.

I saw yellow sand everywhere, and the terrain here is very similar to the ancient battlefield.

Two watchtowers stood on both sides of the camp gate.

Wang Shuo immediately assigned 10 archers to the two watchtowers, 5 people each.

The Black Mountain Bandits guarded the important roads everywhere.
